title: Listening Section 1 - Library Membership Enquiry
instruction: You will hear a telephone conversation between a woman and a librarian about joining a public library. Answer Questions 1-10.

transcript.speaker: Sam
transcript.text: Good afternoon, Eastfield Public Library, Sam speaking.

transcript.speaker: Hannah
transcript.text: Hello. I've just moved to the area and I'd like to join the library.

transcript.speaker: Sam
transcript.text: Welcome to Eastfield. I can take some details over the phone, and you can collect your card later. Could I have your surname, please?

transcript.speaker: Hannah
transcript.text: It's Pryce.

transcript.speaker: Sam
transcript.text: Is that P-R-I-C-E?

transcript.speaker: Hannah
transcript.text: No, it's P-R-Y-C-E.

transcript.speaker: Sam
transcript.text: Thank you. And a mobile number?

transcript.speaker: Sam
transcript.text: 07700 900415. And your address?

transcript.speaker: Hannah
transcript.text: Twenty-seven Willow Road. That's W-I-L-L-O-W.

transcript.speaker: Sam
transcript.text: Got it. We have three kinds of membership: standard, senior and student. Which would suit you?

transcript.speaker: Hannah
transcript.text: I'm studying part-time at the college, so I think student membership.

transcript.speaker: Sam
transcript.text: Then you'll need to show your student card when you collect your card. Student membership is normally eight pounds a year, but there's an offer this month, so it's only five pounds.

transcript.speaker: Hannah
transcript.text: That's very good. Do I need to bring anything else?

transcript.speaker: Sam
transcript.text: Yes, proof of your address. A passport won't do, because it doesn't show where you live, and we can't accept letters from the college either. A recent bank statement or a utility bill is fine.

transcript.speaker: Hannah
transcript.text: I have a bank statement from last month.

transcript.speaker: Sam
transcript.text: Perfect. Your card will be ready on Thursday. We're closed on Wednesdays, so please don't come then.

transcript.speaker: Hannah
transcript.text: Thursday, okay. How many books can I borrow?

transcript.speaker: Sam
transcript.text: It used to be eight, but members can now borrow up to ten books at a time.

transcript.speaker: Hannah
transcript.text: Lovely. And can I reserve a study room? I have some exams coming up.

transcript.speaker: Sam
transcript.text: Yes, but only online. The desk no longer takes bookings, and we don't accept them by phone either.

transcript.speaker: Hannah
transcript.text: That's fine. Is the library open in the evenings?

transcript.speaker: Sam
transcript.text: Most days we close at six, but on Tuesdays we stay open until eight.

transcript.speaker: Hannah
transcript.text: Great. Thank you so much for your help.

transcript.speaker: Sam
transcript.text: You're welcome. See you on Thursday.

questionGroups.groupInstruction: Complete the form below. Write ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.

questions.explanation: The surname is spelled P-R-Y-C-E, after Sam suggests the wrong spelling.
Hannah says Twenty-seven Willow Road and spells Willow.
She is studying part-time, so she chooses student membership.
Student membership is normally eight pounds, but this month's offer is five pounds.
Sam says the card will be ready on Thursday; Wednesday is when the library is closed.

questionGroups.groupInstruction: Choose the correct letter, A, B or C.

questions.questionText: Which document should Hannah bring as proof of address?
questions.explanation: A passport does not show the address and college letters are not accepted. A bank statement or utility bill is fine.

options.optionText: C. a letter from her college

questions.questionText: How many books can members borrow at one time?
questions.explanation: It used to be eight, but members can now borrow up to ten.

questions.questionText: How can Hannah book a study room?
questions.explanation: Study rooms can only be booked online; the desk and phone are not accepted.

questions.questionText: On which day does the library stay open late?
questions.explanation: On Tuesdays the library stays open until eight.
